change: Stage E (the Rosetta authors' unmodified protocol and code) is rerun on the action-word-free captions (AMENDMENT3 features in lexfree/). The jobs, seeds and code are those of AMENDMENT4. Only the text features differ. Image and action features are identical (40,000 moments, same rows), so the 20 image-action jobs must reproduce the original stage E exactly, which serves as a determinism check.
reading: descriptive, secondary (as stage E). Text-action/image-text geometry and FOSCTTM are reported next to the original captions. Image-action must match the original to numerical tolerance, or the difference is reported.
workers: 8 processes x 2 threads (CPU-only upstream solver; machine idle), set with V4N_WORKERS; restart parallelism does not change results
